attributes.title: Secure MCP Gateway - SLO & Reliability
attributes.description: Four Golden Signals + RED method coverage for the MCP gateway. Latency (p50/p95/p99 for tool/guardrail/health/handshake), Traffic (RPS by endpoint/server/direction), Errors (tool/guardrail/auth/MCP protocol/degradation), Saturation (in-flight, pool, CPU/RSS/FDs, event-loop lag, timeout escalations).
